inputs_notas.bod_ft: A100 deck tags: 'PLY DECK @ 17'-1 9/16"' (Sales Area) and 'PLY DECK @ 16'-4"' (Back of House); break not drawn (RFI-01). Heights per wall in the Partition Takeoff.
inputs_notas.drywall_screws_per_sf: YIELD; fasteners EXCLUDED in this project (estimator standing order).

RFI-01.pregunta: The deck break between 'PLY DECK @ 16'-4"' (Back of House) and 'PLY DECK @ 17'-1 9/16"' (Sales Area) is not drawn (deck height not printed at the C3 line). C3-01 studs carried to the higher deck. - CLOSED: CLOSED - user decision 2026-11-05 (option A): studs of C3-01 to the higher printed deck 17'-1 9/16" (A100 PLY DECK tag), as carried; becomes rule U-146 (two printed deck heights and no drawn break = the higher printed height, no RFI). Delta if the BOH deck 16'-4": -22.3 LF of 3-5/8" 18 ga stud. Verify at A100.

RFI-02.pregunta: Type A# 'FURRED WALL TO DECK' (1/A500) prints '5/8" TYPE "X" GYP. BD. ON EACH SIDE TO 6" ABOVE CEILING' but the section draws the board only on the tenant side, with a 1/2" gap to the existing demising wall. Board loaded on BOTH faces as printed in the type note. - CLOSED: CLOSED - resolved by rule U-127 (BOTH SIDES): the 1/A500 type A# note prints '5/8" TYPE "X" GYP. BD. ON EACH SIDE TO 6" ABOVE CEILING' - board on both faces carried. Note: the 1/A500 section draws one face only (1/2" gap to the existing demising wall); delta if one face: -1205.6 SF 5/8" Type X. Verify at 1/A500.

RFI-03.pregunta: 4/A500 long-leg slotted runner track: gauge and leg length not printed (2" min. vertical slots printed); the floating C channel is printed 3 5/8" x 20 GA only - no 6" version for type D (6" studs). Carried: deep-leg slotted track 20 ga (2" deflection leg) by stud size and a nested 20 ga C channel of the wall's stud size. The estimator precedent on runners (O'Reilly: 1-1/2" runner top and bottom of Z-furring, ASTM C754) does not decide this deflection head. - CLOSED: CLOSED - resolved by rule U-052 (printed governs) / R-ALC-10 (drawings govern): 2/A500 'CONT 20 GA BOTTOM TRACK' and 3/A500 / 4/A500 '20 GA. MIN. TRACK' print the track gauge (all tracks carried 20 ga); 4/A500 prints the '3 5/8" X 20 GA. C CHANNEL', applied at the 6" stud size for type D. Delta vs a manufacturer 2-1/2" leg deflection track: 0 LF. Verify at 2/A500, 3/A500, 4/A500.

RFI-04.pregunta: Gypsum board finish level and trims are not specified (no project manual; A700 'ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATIONS' holds only the finish / FF&E schedules; walls painted PT-1..PT-4 eggshell). Carried Level 4 on all board, metal corner bead at outside corners and the cased opening. - CLOSED: CLOSED - user decision 2026-11-05 (option A): Level 4 finish on all gypsum board, as carried; becomes rule U-147 (level of finish not specified = Level 4, no RFI). Delta if Level 5: skim coat on 4,786.89 SF (total gypsum board, Material Summary). Verify at A700.

RFI-05.pregunta: The 4'-0" x 8'-0" cased opening 'OPEN TO HALLWAY' (2/A400) in the C3 line between Hallway and Sales is untagged; the infill above the opening is carried as C3 (studs to deck, board both sides) as the C3 line it continues. - CLOSED: CLOSED - resolved by the drawings: the C3 line continues over the 4'-0" x 8'-0" cased opening (A100 C3 tag at its north end; 2/A400 'OPEN TO HALLWAY', T.O. OPENING 8'-0") - C3 to deck over the opening carried. Delta if E3: -4.0 LF x 4.71 ft of stud. Verify at A100 / 2/A400.

RFI-06.pregunta: Unisex Restroom C-1 gypsum board ceiling at 8'-0" (A200): no ceiling framing detail is bubbled on A200 / A402; A501 'CEILING DETAILS' is referenced from no sheet. Carried as a suspended furring channel system (hangers + carrying + furring, ASTM C754). - CLOSED: CLOSED - resolved by rule U-140 (no bubble is not 'not printed') / R-ALC-10 (drawings govern): 2/A501 INSTALLATION OF SUSPENDED CEILING USING GRID SUSPENSION SYSTEM (5/8" GYP. BD., ICC ESR 1289) is the only gypsum board ceiling detail printed in the set and C-1 restroom is the only gypsum board ceiling. Delta vs the ASTM C754 furring system: +54.25 LF furring channel, +23.0 LF carrying channel, +31.75 LF perimeter track; -23.25 LF main tee, -53.67 LF cross tee, -31.75 LF 2x2 angle. Verify at 2/A501, A200.
RFI-06.delta: grid 2/A501 loaded: main tee 23.25 LF, cross tee 53.67 LF, angle 31.75 LF (replace furring 54.25 LF, carrying 23.0 LF, perimeter track 31.75 LF)

RFI-07.pregunta: Door 3C is a new door in the EXISTING Hallway / Utility wall to remain (D100 keynote 17, A100): the new opening framing (header + jamb studs) in the existing wall is not detailed. Carried: track header (2/A600, R.O. + 1'-4") and 2 jamb studs each side (3/A600) to 6" above the BOH ceiling. - CLOSED: CLOSED - resolved by the drawings: A600 DOOR SCHEDULE door 3C (Utility) prints HEAD 2/A600 and JAMB 3/A600 - track header 4.67 LF and double jamb studs carried. Delta if the existing opening were reused: -4.67 LF header, -49.67 LF 3-5/8" stud. Verify at A600 door schedule row 3C.

RFI-08.pregunta: Mop sink / water heater shelf (1/A504 sections A, B): '6" 16 GA. METAL STUDS ATTACHED WITH #10 TEK SCREWS' and '5/8" WR GYP BD' under the 3/4" FRT plywood are printed, but the number of members is not. Carried: perimeter ledger + joists @ 16" o.c. over the 4'-0" x 2'-4" alcove (between E3-12 / E3-13) and 5/8" WR board top and underside. A700 SHELVES note 'SHELVING ABOVE MOP SINK IS ON DETAIL 6/A500' points to 6/A500 ATTACHMENT TO STRUCTURE (a brace detail, no shelf): the shelf is taken from 1/A504. - CLOSED: CLOSED - resolved by the drawings (U-140): 1/A504 prints the shelf members '6" 16 GA. METAL STUDS ATTACHED WITH #10 TEK SCREWS' and '5/8" WR GYP BD'; the member layout follows the printed stud spacing of the set, 16" o.c. (1/A500 types): perimeter + joists @ 16" o.c. = 19.67 LF, board top + underside 18.67 SF. Delta if perimeter only: -7.0 LF of 6" 16 GA stud. Note: the A700 SHELVES note points to 6/A500, which is ATTACHMENT TO STRUCTURE (no shelf). Verify at 1/A504.

RFI-C1.pregunta: Heights of the existing walls / furring to be demolished (D100 keys 9, 27) are not printed. - CLOSED: estimator decision (standing rule): existing partitions to demolish without printed height go to the printed B.O. structure; A100 'PLY DECK @ 17'-1 9/16"' (higher bay) carried

A/B-1 (door openings).pregunta: Reading A measured the E3 walls without the door gaps of 4C / 5C / 6C - CLOSED by rule: walls measured through the door R.O. (one straight line per tag), openings listed in the wall

A/B-2 (A3 north wall).pregunta: One wall (B) or two (A) on the north sales wall - CLOSED: two A3 tags on the line broken by the existing column (D100 key 14) = two walls; same 43.24 LF

revisar.punto: A3-01 / A3-02 north sales wall stops each side of the existing column (D100 keynote 14, gap ~1'-0"); the column is not wrapped. A: stop at the column (loaded) / B: wrap the column with the furring; delta about +4 LF of A3 and +100 SF of board. Source A100 / D100.

Existing ceiling demolition of D100 keynote 7 (existing gyp. bd. and ACT ceilings, soffit and framing throughout): the extent of gypsum board vs ACT is not shown - EXCLUDED for lack of information (0 SF, estimator decision: standing rule for existing ceilings without type). Review Item: the lease area is 3,103 SF (G003) if the estimator wants an allowance. Source D100 key 7.

Type E3 walls between rooms with different ceilings (Office 9'-0" / BOH 11'-11", Restroom 8'-0" / Hallway 11'-11"): studs to the higher ceiling + 6" and each face's board to its own ceiling + 6" (1/A500 'TO 6" ABOVE CEILING'). A: as loaded / B: board on both faces to the higher ceiling; delta = the lower faces x (higher - lower) ceiling. Source A200 / 1/A500.

Patch and repair of the existing demising / exterior walls to remain (D100 keynotes 3, 4 'PATCH AND REPAIR AS REQUIRED TO LIKE-NEW CONDITION'): area not measurable from the drawings - allowance by the estimator. Source D100 / A100.

Exterior signage blocking: 'G.C. TO VERIFY AND INSTALL BLOCKING FOR EXTERIOR SIGNAGE AS REQUIRED. COORDINATE WITH LANDLORD AND SIGNAGE VENDOR' - on the existing shell, size not shown on the drawings: Review Item - allowance by the estimator (no quantity drawn). Source A300 / A301 note 2.

Logo wall blocking 1/A104: one 1'-4 1/2" band of 20 GA metal strapping per logo wall (cleat 10 1/2" + 3" above and below), loaded as one LF band per wall. A: one band (loaded) / B: 3 rows of 6" strap; delta x3 on BLK-LOGO-S / BLK-LOGO-W. Source 1/A104.

Bottom track 20 ga (2/A500) by stud size; top track in two families: long-leg slotted runner track (4/A500) at A3 / C3 / D to deck + nested 3-5/8" / 6" x 20 ga C channel, and standard 20 ga top track (3/A500) at E3.
